name: web-scraping-demo
description: Demonstrate web scraping capabilities by fetching and analyzing web content

steps.name: scrape-producthunt
steps.prompt:
Scrape Product Hunt for trending products:

URL: https://www.producthunt.com/

Use the web fetch tool to get the page content.

Extract:
- Top 5-7 trending products
- Product name
- Tagline/description
- Vote count
- Categories

Return as structured list. If scraping fails or blocked, note it and try alternative approach.

steps.name: scrape-hackernews-job-board
steps.prompt:
Scrape the Hacker News "Who is Hiring" page or job listings:

Try URLs:
- https://news.ycombinator.com/jobs (if available)
- Or search for recent "Who is Hiring" thread

Extract:
- Company names
- Job titles (if visible)
- Locations (if mentioned)
- Technologies mentioned

Note: HN uses minimal markup, focus on text extraction. Return structured list of opportunities.

steps.name: analyze-scraped-content
steps.prompt:
Analyze the scraped web data and create insights:

**Product Hunt Data:**
{{producthunt_data}}

**Hacker News Job Board:**
{{hn_jobs}}

Task:
1. Identify trends in the Product Hunt products (AI tools? Developer tools? Consumer apps?)
2. Categorize products by type
3. Analyze job board data for in-demand technologies/skills
4. Look for patterns between trending products and job requirements

Return analysis with insights and observations.

steps.name: format-web-scraping-report
steps.prompt:
Create a web scraping demo report for Discord.

**Scraped Data:**
Product Hunt: {{producthunt_data}}

HN Jobs: {{hn_jobs}}

Analysis: {{scraped_analysis}}

FORMAT:
```
🌐 **Web Scraping Demo — {date}**

**🔥 Trending on Product Hunt**
• [Product Name] — Tagline (🔼 XXX votes) — [Category]
• [Product Name] — Tagline (🔼 XXX votes)
• [Product Name] — Tagline (🔼 XXX votes)

**💼 Hacker News Jobs Highlights**
• [Company] — [Role/Stack mentioned]
• [Company] — [Role/Stack mentioned]
• [Company] — [Role/Stack mentioned]

**📊 Insights**
• Trend 1: [What you noticed about trending products]
• Trend 2: [In-demand technologies or skills]
• Trend 3: [Connection between products and jobs]

_Web data scraped live — OpenFang Web Scraper Demo_
```

Note any scraping challenges encountered. Keep under 1800 characters. This demonstrates OpenFang's web scraping capabilities.
